# Causa v1.0.0 event catalog

<!-- GENERATED by tools/causa-contract/generate_catalogs.py from schemas/ and catalog/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Normative. The registry is closed: exactly these 31 discriminators, in engine `EventBody` order. Any other
`eventType` string makes the whole history invalid (`CAUSA.UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE`, stage 6); a non-string `eventType` is
`CAUSA.SCHEMA_VIOLATION` (stage 7). Unknown events are never skipped, preserved-and-ignored, or mapped to a generic
event (INVARIANTS.md I-11).

## Envelope (every line of `events.ndjson`)

| JSON path | JSON type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `$.formatVersion` | string | Wire format version. |
| `$.eventId` | string | Event identity, UUIDv5(241fefd4-c810-5a3a-9cfa-4bbd968ae1cb, investigationId + "/" + aggregateVersion + "/" + correlationId). |
| `$.investigationId` | string | Investigation the event belongs to. |
| `$.aggregateVersion` | integer | Position in the history; 1..N in file order. |
| `$.eventType` | string enum (inline) | Event discriminator selecting the payload schema. |
| `$.occurredAt` | string | Time the producing command was decided (engine RequestedAt), millisecond UTC. |
| `$.actor` | object (actor.schema.json#/$defs/actor) | Actor who issued the producing command. |
| `$.actor.actorId` (kind=human|system) | string | Stable, non-secret, non-personal actor identifier. |
| `$.actor.kind` (kind=human|system) | string enum (inline) | Actor kind. "agent" actors MAY appear only on ProposalRecorded events (D-004). |
| `$.actor.actorId` (kind=agent) | string | Stable, non-secret, non-personal actor identifier. |
| `$.actor.kind` (kind=agent) | string | Actor kind. "agent" actors MAY appear only on ProposalRecorded events (D-004). |
| `$.actor.provider` (kind=agent) | string | AI provider of an agent actor. |
| `$.actor.model` (kind=agent) | string | AI model of an agent actor. |
| `$.semanticVersion` | string | Semantic (domain meaning) version. |
| `$.correlationId` | string | Id of the producing command; shared by all events of one command group. |
| `$.payload` | object | Event-specific data; shape selected by eventType. |

Envelope rules: `eventId = UUIDv5(241fefd4-c810-5a3a-9cfa-4bbd968ae1cb, investigationId + "/" + aggregateVersion + "/" + correlationId)`
(decimal version, lowercase UUID text, UTF-8 name). Ordering is by `aggregateVersion` only (1..N, file order); clocks
never order. One command = one or more consecutive events sharing `correlationId`, `occurredAt` and `actor`; a
`correlationId` never names two non-adjacent groups. See CONTRACT.md §5 and INVARIANTS.md.

| Permitted actor kinds | `human` or `system` only (an `agent` actor is a schema violation, D-004) |

| Projection effect (CONTRACT §8.3) | creates state: `investigationId`, `title`, `lifecycle: "draft"`, `createdAt: occurredAt`, `observations: [{id: observationId, original, observedAt: null}]`, every other array `[]` |
| Introduced | 1.0.0 |

| `$.payload.observationId` | string | no | lowercase canonical UUID `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`, not nil | Id of the initial observation created with the investigation. |
| `$.payload.original` | string | no | non-blank verbatim text: minLength 1 and at least one char outside the engine whitespace set; never trimmed/normalized; minLength 1 | Initial observation, verbatim. |

| Creates | — |

Payload fields (all keys required; payload object closed):

| JSON path | JSON type | Nullable | Constraint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$.payload.from` | string enum `lifecycle` | no | one of `draft`, `active`, `awaitingEvidence`, `awaitingVerification`, `resolved`, `closed`, `archived`; closed lowerCamelCase set | Lifecycle before the change. |
| `$.payload.to` | string enum `lifecycleTarget` | no | one of `active`, `awaitingEvidence`, `awaitingVerification`, `resolved`, `closed`; closed lowerCamelCase set | Lifecycle after the change. |
| `$.payload.command` | string enum `lifecycleCommand` | no | one of `activateInvestigation`, `markAwaitingEvidence`, `markAwaitingVerification`, `resolveInvestigation`, `closeInvestigation`, `reopenInvestigation`, `verificationFailed`; closed lowerCamelCase set | Command that caused the change; distinguishes resolve/reopen/verification-failure. |
| `$.payload.reason` | string | yes | non-blank verbatim text: minLength 1 and at least one char outside the engine whitespace set; never trimmed/normalized; minLength 1 | Reason or basis; present for markAwaitingEvidence, reopenInvestigation, verificationFailed. |

Schema-level conditional invariants:
- if `command` = "activateInvestigation" then `to` = "active"
- if `command` = "activateInvestigation" then `reason` is null
- if `command` = "markAwaitingEvidence" then `to` = "awaitingEvidence"
- if `command` = "markAwaitingEvidence" then `reason` must be text
- if `command` = "markAwaitingVerification" then `to` = "awaitingVerification"
- if `command` = "markAwaitingVerification" then `reason` is null
- if `command` = "resolveInvestigation" then `to` = "resolved"
- if `command` = "resolveInvestigation" then `reason` is null
- if `command` = "closeInvestigation" then `to` = "closed"
- if `command` = "closeInvestigation" then `reason` is null
- if `command` = "reopenInvestigation" then `to` = "active"
- if `command` = "reopenInvestigation" then `reason` must be text
- if `command` = "verificationFailed" then `to` = "active"
- if `command` = "verificationFailed" then `reason` must be text
- if `command` = "verificationFailed" then `from` = "awaitingVerification"

Reference constraints (an id that names no existing entity makes the history inadmissible):
- none

Semantic invariants (normative detail and rule codes in [SEMANTICS.md](SEMANTICS.md)):
- `from` MUST equal the replayed lifecycle.
- The (from, command, to) triple MUST be a legal lifecycle transition (SEMANTICS.md lifecycle table) and its gates MUST pass (resolution gate for resolveInvestigation).
- `verificationFailed` is never issued directly: it is the follow-on of VerificationRecorded(outcome failed) while awaitingVerification.

| `$.payload.evidenceIds` | array<uuid> | no | items: lowercase canonical UUID `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`, not nil; ordered (citation order), distinct (uniqueItems), not sorted | Cited evidence, in citation order. |

Schema-level conditional invariants:
- if `command` = "markPlausible" then `to` = "plausible"
- if `command` = "markSupported" then `to` = "supported"
- if `command` = "markWeakened" then `to` = "weakened"
- if `command` = "falsify" then `to` = "falsified"
- if `command` = "supersede" then `to` = "superseded"
- if `command` = "reopen" then `to` = "plausible"
- if `command` = "markSupported" then `evidenceIds` must be nonEmptyUuidList
- if `command` = "markWeakened" then `evidenceIds` must be nonEmptyUuidList
- if `command` = "falsify" then `evidenceIds` must be nonEmptyUuidList
- if `command` = "reopen" then `evidenceIds` must be nonEmptyUuidList

Reference constraints (an id that names no existing entity makes the history inadmissible):
- `hypothesisId` → existing `hypotheses`
- `evidenceIds[]` → existing `evidence`

Semantic invariants (normative detail and rule codes in [SEMANTICS.md](SEMANTICS.md)):
- `from` MUST equal the replayed hypothesis state.
- (from, command, to) MUST be a legal hypothesis transition.
- reopen requires evidence admitted after the latest falsification (new evidence).
- The change's `at`/`aggregateVersion` are the envelope's occurredAt/aggregateVersion.
